subject: Incubator credits bridge + rollback policy request
messages:
From: Kate Morales <kate@asterincubator.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aster Incubator Finance <finance@asterincubator.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary bridge credits + rollback for cohort pilot

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — the founders on our spring cohort were really impressed with the latency and cost controls you showed. A quick ask from our ops side: several teams want to run a 6-week pilot that will spike usage in week 2 and 3. Budget owners are pushing back on committing to Dedicated capacity up-front.

Can Redwood provide a short-term "bridge" of promotional credits (~$12k equivalent) that we can apply to cohort accounts, with a narrow rollback clause if they don’t convert to a committed Dedicated plan within 90 days? We need clarity on:
- How credits are applied (account-level vs pooled)
- What triggers a rollback and how it’s communicated to founders
- Whether a partial conversion (some teams convert, some don’t) changes reclaim logic

I attached our standard accelerator terms for context. Happy to hop on a 20m call if easier.

Cheers,
Kate Morales
Program Director | Aster Incubator
Kate@asterincubator.com

Attachment: accelerator_terms.pdf (stub)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Morales <kate@asterincubator.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary bridge credits + rollback for cohort pilot

Kate — thanks for the clear ask and the terms doc, appreciate the context. Short answers up-front: we can do a bridged credit package with a limited rollback, but we’ll want defined usage thresholds and a monitoring window to reduce abuse/risk.

Quick proposal for you to review:
- Offer: $12,000 promotional credit pool applied at the incubator org level, tagged per-founder so we can report consumption per team.
- Duration: credits valid for 60 days from issuance; if a team converts to Dedicated within 90 days we honor credits applied to that team toward a first-month offset.
- Rollback: any unconverted credits older than 90 days are eligible for reclaiming; we'll notify account admins 30 days before reclaim with a consumption report. Reclaimed tokens are not retroactively billed to founders — reclaimed credits expire.
- Partial conversions: credits are liquid — converted teams keep their applied portion; leftover pool is subject to rollback rules.

Operational asks from our side: we need an internal contact that will approve which founder accounts are eligible (CSV), and a single point for invoicing adjustments. If you’re good with the direction I’ll draft a short addendum (1 page) and loop finance for the approval.

Cc'ing Ben and Priyom to align on pricing levers (discount vs credits) and 1-pg addendum language.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: draft-rollback-term.docx (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary bridge credits + rollback for cohort pilot

Quick internal note — for DEAL-1437 I recommend offering a hybrid: promotional credit pool ($12k) + optional first-month 25% off for any team that converts to Dedicated within 60 days. Rationale: credits lower the bar for trial, the conversion discount reduces friction to commit.

Operational guardrails I'd propose:
- Per-team credit cap $2,500 to avoid one team consuming the pool.
- Auto-telemetry alert if a single account uses >40% of pool in a 7-day window.
- Set a hard cap on concurrency (max N active pilot teams) tied to the cohort size you share.

If Legal needs to avoid the phrase "rollback" we can frame it as "credit expiration and reallocation" in the addendum. I added the HubSpot deal link with preliminary terms: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1437

Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Kate Morales <kate@asterincubator.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Aster Incubator Finance <finance@asterincubator.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 10:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary bridge credits + rollback for cohort pilot

Vanessa, Ben — this looks workable, thank you. A few clarifications from Finance:
- We’ll provide the CSV of eligible founders by next Tuesday.
- The per-team cap of $2,500 is fine; request that the alert threshold be set to 50% of pool (we’ll triage if it fires).
- One additional ask: can you include a brief sentence about data retention/telemetry for pilot accounts (we need assurance founders’ PII is not stored beyond standard logs). I can share our SOC2 excerpt as a follow-up.

If you can push the addendum and a short invoice line describing the credit pool, we’ll sign and process.

Thanks,
Kate
Program Director | Aster Incubator
Kate@asterincubator.com

Kate — thanks, we’ll get the addendum over by end of day Monday. Notes captured: 2.5k per-team cap, alert at 50% pool usage, explicit telemetry/data retention sentence included.

Next steps:
1) Send eligible founder CSV to partnerships@redwood.ai
2) We’ll provision the $12k credit pool (tagged per founder) and send invoice line for accounting.
3) Addendum + one-line invoice delivered; credit activation after invoice is accepted (standard for promo pools).

I’ll loop Legal on the wording but intend to use "credit expiration and reallocation" instead of the word "reclaim" to keep the tone neutral.

Vanessa Ortiz
